Diphtherinum.



A nosode. Trituration of diphtheric membrane. Dilutions of diphtheria
        toxin.



Clinical. ─   Croup. Diphtheria. Diphtheritic
        paralysis. Myelitis.



Characteristics. ─   The well-known features of the
        disease of which this nosode is a product must be the guide to its use. It should be more
        efficacious in the potencies against diphtheria, both as prophylactic and cure, than the
        serum injections. In all probability it will be found useful in the paralysis of diphtheria
        and other like kinds of spinal affection. It needs clinical development and a proving in the
        potencies.
